name: Meal Prep Molly
tagline: Your weekly grocery restock, collapsed into one message
description: Holds the standing list of household staples and turns each week's restock into a single order placed through a grocery delivery service. Ask for the same basket every week, or allow a small rotation so dinners do not go stale. The chore shrinks to reading one message and nodding.

notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
